frozen_scoring_policy.goal_success: Externally adjudicated: every required criterion passes; product goal_coverage is telemetry only.
frozen_scoring_policy.external_coverage: Fraction of required fixed criteria satisfied in the final answer.
frozen_scoring_policy.numeric_accuracy: Named target must appear with correct scenario/meaning and numeric value within frozen absolute tolerance; digits elsewhere do not count.
frozen_scoring_policy.unit_accuracy: Each matched numeric target must carry the stated or mathematically equivalent unit. dimensionless must be explicitly identified; percent and percentage_point are distinct.
frozen_scoring_policy.typed_accuracy: Exact label/set/ranking correctness; order matters for ranking, ties are accepted only where frozen.
frozen_scoring_policy.contract_output_matching: Semantic name and scenario association are required; aliases allowed only when unambiguous. Report recall, precision, unit accuracy, scenario coverage; complete only when all required targets represented.
frozen_scoring_policy.result_contract_complete: All required output IDs present, typed and unit-bearing as required, required input IDs used and formula ID used when applicable.
frozen_scoring_policy.gt_correct_calc: A successful validated subprocess produced a contract-complete CALC; all required numeric, unit, typed and ranking targets match independent GT.
frozen_scoring_policy.grounded_adoption: Correct CALC values and units are used in final answer with CALC provenance; specialist formula also has original KB formula citation; USERF is not KB-only attributed.
frozen_scoring_policy.strong_python_benefit: OFF fails a required numeric/goal criterion, ON has GT-correct CALC adopted with grounding, and the same criterion passes ON.
frozen_scoring_policy.weak_numeric_improvement: ON numeric target accuracy exceeds OFF but no GT-correct adopted CALC supports the gain; do not conflate with strong benefit.
frozen_scoring_policy.failure_attribution: Use all iterations; classify retrieval, recovery, registries, planner, materialization, contract, verification, code, sandbox, runtime, result, CALC GT, grounding, adoption, final synthesis.
frozen_scoring_policy.review: One blind gemma4:latest semantic reviewer; deterministic numeric/unit/CALC scorer authoritative. Preserve raw and separate adjudicated v1.1.
frozen_scoring_policy.bootstrap: Paired 10000 resamples seed 42, percentile 95% CI overall12 required8 pipeline6; exploratory small-sample inference only.
frozen_scoring_policy.provenance: User values cite USERF, source facts cite original KB/FIG source, formula-derived results cite CALC and original formula source.
frozen_scoring_policy.safety: No WEB, no GT source/page/value leakage to recovery, at most one recovery query per task. Product failures score as results; infrastructure aborts incomplete run.
